clearing_house_active.meaning: clearingHouse.active flag indicating whether the protocol is active (true) or paused/deactivated (false)

deposit_withdraw_operation.meaning: a deposit or withdrawal fund-movement operation is executed

fund_ops_blocked_when_paused.meaning: deposit and withdrawal operations are blocked (rejected) while the protocol is inactive/paused
fund_ops_blocked_when_paused.checkpoint: at execution of deposit/withdraw function while clearingHouse.active is false

new_deposit_lost.meaning: newly deposited funds are lost after being deposited into a protocol with known critical issues

claims.scope: New deposits can be lost if deposited into a protocol with known critical issues

preconditions.text: Protocol administrators have called deactivateProtocol() to pause trading operations, so clearingHouse.active is false.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: When the protocol is inactive (paused), deposit and withdrawal operations must be blocked, consistent with the onlyActiveProtocol protection applied to trading functions.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: New deposits can be lost if deposited into a protocol with known critical issues
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: clearingHouse.active is the observable pause flag referenced by the onlyActiveProtocol modifier.
Deposit and withdrawal operations are the fund-movement functions named in the report.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; new_deposit_lost is encoded as a Boolean outcome without a numeric magnitude.
The authorization guard's effect/authorization are represented by grounded Booleans because the report does not give a numeric or address-valued observable for the block relation.
